overview.en:
Connect Xero’s official MCP for accounting records, invoices, contacts, financial reports and payroll workflows.

Explore accounting records and prepare financial summaries with a clear reporting period. Preserve account and currency context when reconciling totals or investigating differences.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接 Xero 官方 MCP，处理会计记录、发票、联系人、财务报表和工资办公流程。

围绕明确的报告期查询会计记录、准备财务摘要；核对汇总或调查差异时保留科目与币种信息。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available financial reports for last month.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总上个月的可用财务报表。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate the records behind this unexpected expense change.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 调查这项费用异常变化背后的记录。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a reconciliation checklist from these accounting records.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据这些会计记录准备对账检查清单。

descriptions.en: Use Xero in Ghast. Connect Xero’s official MCP for accounting records, invoices, contacts, financial reports and payroll workflows. 连接 Xero 官方 MCP，处理会计记录、发票、联系人、财务报表和工资办公流程。
